7404.title: Host-managed routing drops settings-sourced model overrides
7404.rootCauseOneLine: The pool’s host-managed flag makes Claude reject local-settings model env overrides; process-env overrides still work and warnings are debug-only.
7404.proposedFix: Preserve login isolation; choose documented model-default precedence or expose an actionable ignored-settings notice. Do not blanket-promote settings env.
7404.caveats: Pinned CLI 2.1.318; local deterministic API fixture, no live pool or paid inference. Workflow override and user-global settings not verified. No automatic fix because configuration policy and auth isolation require review.
